identity_factors.statement: attribution_portfolio_return - sum of factor contributions == alpha + residual

return_conventions.why: daily_return applies each holding's adjusted return to yesterday's as-traded market value; attribution_portfolio_return revalues the book at total-return prices on both days, which is what the betas were fitted against. They differ by the holdings' dividend history.

factor_note: These factors are collinear (max VIF above 5). Their SUM is well determined; no single beta is. Quote the total factor contribution, not one coefficient.
